== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rectenna (Japanese)|Rectenna]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67713 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(22, 16, 448, 622)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>11ba4d17a6dd8a40817a269b6e65407e86d4d7f1ab505b80fd80d9935481adfe</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-3/3d/Japanese-ANH-Rectenna-SWCA-67713.jpg Internet Archive item].
